name: postgres
description: Read-only access to a PostgreSQL database through the official Model Context Protocol PostgreSQL server. Run ad-hoc SQL, list tables, describe schemas, inspect indexes and foreign keys, sample rows, and analyze query plans — all enforced as read-only at the server protocol level.

interface.shortDescription: Query any PostgreSQL database through the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can safely explore and query your PostgreSQL databases — listing tables, inspecting schemas, running ad-hoc SQL, and analyzing query performance. All queries run in read-only mode, so your data stays safe even in production. No more opening your database client for every quick question: just ask your agent what's in a table, how the schema looks, or to find specific records.
defaultPrompt: Show me the tables and their schemas in my database.
Find the top 10 most recent records in this table.
Run a query to answer this business question from my data.
